actions.action: Isolate the plant from other houseplants
Shake a branch to see if tiny white flies flutter up
Inspect leaf undersides with phone macro or magnifier for specks and sticky honeydew
Rinse leaf undersides with strong water stream or wipe with damp cloth
Test spray on one leaf and wait a day
Spray undersides with insecticidal soap or neem oil every 5-7 days for 3-4 weeks
Place yellow sticky traps near the plant
Vacuum adults off the plant with handheld vacuum in the morning
Inspect other plants for the same pests
Shake flowers gently to aid pollination
If infestation keeps growing, use pyrethrin-based spray labeled for edibles
Post a close-up photo of the specks or report whether anything flies off

reason: The answer diagnoses whiteflies rather than aphids, but its neem oil spray step matches the fix that worked, though it is mixed in among many other steps, and nothing it suggests would harm the plant.
